hypotheses.description: A tighter executable min_amount_out can buy greedy AB execution priority and raise the reporter's output.
hypotheses.key_finding: With two 10000 exact-in swaps, Alice's loose min_out=0 executes second and receives 9706; raising her executable min_out to 9000 makes greedy_ab execute her first and receive 9900.

hypotheses.description: Ceil-rounded exact-in fees are superadditive under order splitting in the bounded Wave 1 grid.
hypotheses.key_finding: Across all fee rates 0..10000 and every two-way partition of gross amounts 0..64, sum(split fees) >= one-shot fee; representative consensus-helper probes match the closed-form ceil formula.

hypotheses.description: Identical exact-in swap ties have positive output value because the lower intent_id executes first.
hypotheses.key_finding: Two identical 10000 exact-in swaps tie under limit_price; the lower intent_id receives 9900 and the higher receives 9706, so the tie value is 194 output units.

hypotheses.description: Adding one rejected dust intent across _MAX_SWAP_ORDERING_BRUTE_FORCE_N strictly lowers a victim's fill via the silent optimal_ab_bounded to limit_price fallback.
hypotheses.key_finding: With the bound reduced 12 to 3 on the live compute_settlement path, one 1-unit dust intent (itself rejected with zero output) flips the victim from fill 47619 to REJECT(SLIPPAGE) while the same dust added below the bound is harmless; at the untouched constant 12, the n=13 fallback returns exactly the limit_price order and rejects the victim, and n=3 brute force reorders and fills it. The literal 12-intent brute-force side is not replayable (12! = 479001600 orderings), so the production crossing is bound branch-by-branch.

hypotheses.description: The same one-intent bound crossing strictly lowers the global (A, B) settlement objective; cardinality alone selects between the two pricing regimes.
hypotheses.key_finding: Across the reduced bound the settled objective drops from (A, B) = (50000, 619) to (10000, 100); at the untouched constant the identical 3-intent instance settles (50000, 619) under optimal_ab_bounded and (10000, 100) under limit_price, and n=13 under optimal_ab_bounded settles at the limit_price objective.

hypotheses.description: CoW self-netting captures fees and spread relative to pool execution for a self-supplied counter-intent pair.
hypotheses.key_finding: The A->B and B->A self pair nets at 100/100 with zero fees and no reserve deltas under cow_pair_netting_v1; the same pair through pool execution pays total fee 2, receives 98/99, and moves reserves.

hypotheses.description: Three-way fee dust-carry conserves value and leaves a tight dust bound below three fee units.
hypotheses.key_finding: For representative fee, dust, and routing-share cases, distributed + next dust equals fee + previous dust at each split, next dust equals the receipt dust, and dust_carried < 3; repeated splits conserve cumulative value.
